name: Social Media Post Generation with Jev Judge

parameters.formTitle: Social Media Post Generation with Jev Judge
parameters.formDescription: Upload the provided 10-request CSV to generate posts, or a reviewed Evaluation Log CSV to judge saved posts. Each request must include an Approved facts: section. Generation keeps existing posts; use blank Model_Output cells for a new run.

parameters.content:
## Social media evaluation
Generate 10 posts, then mark PASS or FAIL for Factual Correctness, Clarity, Value / Insight, Engagement and Tone Fit. The workbook calculates Overall: all five PASS = PASS; any FAIL = FAIL.

Attach your OpenAI API credential to Generate Post (combined workflow only) and Independent LLM Review. Call Jev uses its own TypeSafe Header Auth (Authorization: Bearer <TypeSafe API key>). Never put keys in Code nodes.

Generation exports request ID, brief and post for Evaluation Log. Keep original posts and reviews; add reruns as new labelled rows in Evaluation Log. Save failed posts in Failure Traces and update Failure Analysis. Legacy dimension-judge results contain one row per dimension plus Overall; keep the downloaded CSV beside the workbook. The current optional category judge is Social Media LLM Category Judge.json. Judges never receive human labels or each other's answers. Failed calls are not quality FAILs.
